caption: Toda-Yamamoto Granger F-statistics at lags 1–12, both directions. Cass Freight → SPY (vermillion, forward) does NOT clear the 5% line at any lag (min p 0.39). SPY → Cass Freight (pale blue, reverse) is significant at lags [1, 2, 3, 5, 6]. This reverse-only pattern says equities move first and freight follows — freight is a coincident/lagging demand overlay, not a forward forecaster.
narrative_alignment_note: Both directions shown; forward absent, reverse dominates — the honest lagging-indicator causality picture.
